chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, passed by a group of people lifting a stone, and he said: “What is this, and what is it that calls you to it?” They said: “So that we may know which of us is the strongest and most powerful.” He said: “Shall I not direct you to the strongest and most powerful among you?” They said: “Yes, O Messenger of Allah.”

He said: “The strongest and most powerful among you is the one who, when pleased, his pleasure does not lead him into sin or falsehood; and when angry, his anger does not bring him out of speaking the truth; and when he possesses power, he does not take what is not his.”
And in another report: “And when he has power, he does not take what is not his by right.”

key_terms.أَشَدُّكُمْ وَ أَقْوَاكُمْ: the truly strongest and most powerful among people
key_terms.مَا لَيْسَ لَهُ: what does not belong to him

ai.seo_question: Who is the strongest person according to the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that true strength is not physical force, but moral self-mastery. The truly strong person remains just in pleasure, truthful in anger, and restrained from violating the rights of others when in power.
